log.text: The bell over Lumenfall Annex rings without sound. A healer presses two fingers to the warded glass and watches a hairline crack glow gold. A student waits with a stack of unused bandages.
A soundless bell and a cracked ward have interrupted morning lessons at Lumenfall Annex.

chatRuntime.scene: Lumenfall Annex, 5 Leaffall 1153 AC, 08:30. The bell above the healing ward swings without sound. A thin golden crack crosses the wardglass. A healer has just warned apprentice Ivar Wick to keep clear until the cause is known. His lanternfen fox partner Nacre has turned toward the glass. A student holds unused bandages nearby. Ivar has not yet acted.
